description: Submit the user's own product for a free launch day on PebbleLaunch. Only submit products the user owns and has asked you to list. Returns an id, a one-time status_key (save it) and ownership-proof options. Next: add ONE proof on the product's domain (a .well-known file, a meta tag, or a DNS TXT record), then call check_status. The maker then confirms by email; nothing is listed before a human confirms. Rules: https://pebblelaunch.com/rules.

description.description: ≤600 chars, plain text, no links; claims must match the site

maker_email.description: The maker's email; we send it a confirmation link (and at most one reminder). Never shown publicly.

maker_name.description: Person or company shown as maker

preferred_date.description: Optional UTC day YYYY-MM-DD, tomorrow or later

url.description: https:// product URL on the maker's own domain

name: submit_product
title: Submit a product to PebbleLaunch
